meta.description: Scan your medicine, hear how to take am for your own language, and get reminder when time reach.

header.languageHint: Choose the language wey you want for this app
header.readAloudUnavailable: Reading out no dey work for this browser yet.
header.voiceMissing: This phone no get {language} voice yet. Read the card, or ask your pharmacist.

landing.lead: Scan the label and hear am for Igbo, Yoruba, Hausa, Pidgin or English. Get reminders for any phone. Your pharmacist go see when you need help.
landing.previewLabel: Live preview · One prescription, five languages
landing.previewVoiceMissing: This phone never get {language} voice. Read the sentence instead.
landing.howTitle: From pharmacy counter reach the correct dose for house
landing.howIntro: Four steps, no reading needed. Every step dey work offline and fall back to SMS.
landing.step1Body: Point the camera for the label or prescription. AI go read drug, dose and NAFDAC number.
landing.step2Body: Instructions dey talk for your language, with plain words.
landing.step3Body: Reminders by app, SMS or voice call. Caregivers go hear if you miss one dose.
landing.step4Body: Danger words like “chest pain” go alert your pharmacist and show the nearest clinic.
landing.viewsIntro: Every hospital get im own verified space. Staff and patients dey checked against the hospital records.
landing.viewsPatientsSees: Today doses, progress, supply wey remain
landing.viewsPatientsDoes: Scan, listen, ask with voice, check in
landing.phoneLabel: E dey work for any phone
landing.phoneTitle: No smartphone? No data? We still cover you.
landing.phoneBody: Reminders dey come by SMS or voice call. Reply 1 when you don take am. The app still dey work offline and go sync later.
landing.phoneSms: 08:00 Mama Nkechi, take Lisinopril 10mg now. Reply 1 if you don take am, 2 if you never.
landing.phoneFigure: One basic phone wey dey show the SMS reminder and the reply “1”.
landing.safeIntro: The AI dey explain and remind. Decisions stay with licensed professionals.
landing.safe1Body: No prescribing, no dose changes. Questions wey no clear go reach your pharmacist.
landing.safe2Body: Emergency words dey catch before any AI run.
landing.safe3Body: Consent first, encrypted records, download or delete your data.
landing.safe4Body: Forum posts na only from licensed MDCN, PCN and NMCN professionals.
landing.ctaTitle: See am work inside one minute.
landing.ctaBody: Pick one role: patient, pharmacist or hospital admin.
landing.previewAudioSoon: Audio for this language dey come. Read the sentence for now.

errors.codeWrong: That code no match the one wey we send.
errors.too_many: Five wrong codes, so this code don die. Press 'Send new code' and type the new one.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.intro: Pick your hospital and wetin you dey do there. We go check your details for the hospital list, then text code to the phone number wey the hospital get for you.
signup.hospitalHint: You no see your hospital? E never join Medisent AI. Ask the records desk.
signup.noHospital: No hospital — I dey manage my own medicine
signup.fullNameHint: Write am the way the hospital write am, like Chidinma Okafor.
signup.staffIdHint: The ID for your hospital badge, like AH-PH-001.
signup.hospitalNumberHint: For your hospital card, like AH-0002.
signup.phoneHint: The number wey you give the hospital. The code go that number, no be new one.
signup.phoneHintIndependent: We go text the code to this number.
signup.languageHint: The app go talk and write to you for this language.
signup.consent: I agree make Medisent AI keep my details and medicines to remind me and help my hospital take care of me (NDPA 2023). I fit download or delete my data anytime.

rejected.label: No match
rejected.title: We no fit find you for the hospital list
rejected.body: The name, ID and role wey you type no match the hospital list. Check the spelling of your name and your ID, then try again. If you sure say dem correct, ask the records desk for your hospital make dem check the list.
rejected.attempts: {count, plural, =0 {No try remain. This ID don block now.} one {You get # more try. After that this ID go block and the hospital admin must unblock am.} other {You get # more tries. After that this ID go block and the hospital admin must unblock am.}}
rejected.tryAgain: Check my details and try again

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.title: This ID don block for now
blocked.body: Three tries no match the hospital list, so we stop for safety. We don tell the hospital admin. Go the records desk for your hospital with your ID; dem fit unblock you.

exists.label: Already registered
exists.title: You already get account
exists.body: Account already dey for this ID. If na your own, sign in with your phone number. If no be your own, tell the records desk for your hospital today.

errors.hospitalRequired: Pick your hospital from the list, or choose 'No hospital'.
errors.hospitalNotApproved: This hospital never approve. Ask the records desk when e go approve.
errors.roleRequired: Tell us wetin you dey do: patient, doctor, pharmacist, nurse or hospital admin.
errors.staffNeedHospital: Hospital staff must pick their hospital. Na only patients fit sign up without one.
errors.consentRequired: Tick the box to agree, then press Continue.
errors.nameRequired: Type your full name as the hospital write am.
errors.noPhoneOnFile: The hospital list no get phone number for you, so we no fit send code. Ask the records desk make dem add your number, then try again.
errors.sessionExpired: You wait pass 30 minutes, so we stop for safety. Fill the form again.
errors.notConfigured: This app never set up finish, so sign-up no dey work. Tell the person wey dey run am.
errors.server: Something spoil for our side, no be your own. Press Continue to try again. Your details still dey here.
errors.licenceMismatch: This licence number no be the one for the hospital list. Check am, or ask the records desk.

signup.licenceBodyHint: MDCN for doctors, PCN for pharmacists, NMCN for nurses.
signup.licenceNoHint: We dey keep the number wey dey the hospital list.

errors.noPhoneOnFile: This account no get phone number, so we no fit send code. Ask the records desk make dem add one.
errors.notConfigured: This app never set up finish, so sign-in no dey work. Tell the person wey dey run am.

registerHospital.title: Register your hospital
registerHospital.intro: Tell us about the hospital and the person wey go manage am. We go check the licence and approve inside two working days.
registerHospital.name: Hospital name
registerHospital.cacHint: The Corporate Affairs Commission number, like RC 123456.
registerHospital.brandColorHint: E go show as thin line under the header for every screen.
registerHospital.logoHint: PNG, JPG, SVG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
registerHospital.licenceHint: PDF or photo, up to 10 MB. Na only platform admin go see am.
registerHospital.adminIntro: This person go sign up as hospital admin after approval and upload the staff and patient lists.
registerHospital.staffIdHint: Any ID wey your hospital dey use, like AH-AD-001. You go sign up with am later.
registerHospital.reviewNote: Nothing go show for public until approval.

done.label: Sent for review
done.title: Thank you. We dey review your hospital.
done.body: {hospital} dey pending now. We don send SMS with the staff ID to the admin phone, and we go send another one when the review finish, usually inside two working days.
done.staffId: After approval, sign up as hospital admin with staff ID
